studio.privacy.contactLine: Write to us if you have a question about your data.
studio.privacy.cookiesLine: One cookie keeps you signed in. Your browser also remembers small preferences, such as your theme and which studios you have opened. Analytics cookies show us which pages and tools people use, so we can make them better. There are no advertising cookies.
studio.privacy.deletePost: → Delete account removes your account, your runs, your files and your GPU connection at once.
studio.privacy.gpuLine: When you connect your own GPU, your runs go to it from Fuobe, and the results come back to your account.
studio.privacy.howLongLine: Uploads are deleted after 14 days. Your runs and what they made are deleted after 30 days, so download anything you want to keep.
studio.privacy.keptLine: Your email address, and a protected form of your password: the password itself is never stored. The pictures, clips and sound you upload, and everything you make. The address of the GPU you connect, so your runs can reach it.
studio.privacy.keysLine: Provider keys are encrypted at rest and never sent to a third party.
studio.privacy.lead: What Fuobe keeps when you use it, for how long, and how to remove it.
studio.privacy.openLine: Fuobe is open source, so you can read exactly how it handles your data
studio.privacy.runsLine: Prompts and settings are kept so you can reuse them; results stay until you delete them.
studio.privacy.shareLine: When you make a share link, anyone who has that link can see what it shares.
studio.privacy.title: Privacy
studio.privacy.uploadsLine: Files you upload stay on your account's storage until you delete them.
studio.privacy.whoLine: Fuobe is an open-source studio run by a small team. No ad network, no data broker.
studio.privacy.whoSeeLine: The Fuobe team can see what you upload and make, to keep the service working and safe. We don't sell your data, and we don't show it to anyone else.
studio.privacy.yourRightsLine: Export or delete your data at any time from Settings.
